name: Easy!Appointments
description: Open-source appointment scheduler: customers book services with your providers on a public page, and you manage calendars, services, customers and working hours from an admin panel, with a private MySQL database and a preconfigured administrator.

fields.label: Admin email
fields.help: Used for the account and as the company contact address. Change both later in Settings.

prepare.title: Install and create the administrator
prepare.description: Runs Easy!Appointments' own installer: creates the database tables and the administrator account. Skipped when the app is already installed.
prepare.command:
set -eu
base=http://127.0.0.1
jar=$(mktemp)
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -c "$jar" "$base/index.php/installation")
if [ "$code" != 200 ]; then echo "easyappointments is already installed"; exit 0; fi
token=$(curl -s -b "$jar" -c "$jar" "$base/index.php/installation" | grep -o '"csrf_token":"[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -z "$token" ]; then echo "ERR: no csrf token on the installer page"; exit 1; fi
out=$(curl -s -m 120 -b "$jar" -c "$jar" -X POST "$base/index.php/installation/perform" \
  --data-urlencode "csrf_token=$token" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[first_name]=Admin" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[last_name]=User" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[email]=$EA_ADMIN_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[phone_number]=" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[username]=admin" \
  --data-urlencode "admin[password]=$EA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "company[company_name]=My Company" \
  --data-urlencode "company[company_email]=$EA_ADMIN_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "company[company_link]=$BASE_URL")
case "$out" in
  *'"success":true'*) echo "easyappointments administrator ready" ;;
  *) echo "ERR: installation failed: $(echo "$out" | cut -c1-160)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

features.title: Online booking page
features.description: Customers pick a service, provider and time slot from a public page, no account needed.

features.title: Providers, services and working plans
features.description: Manage who offers what, their working hours, breaks and appointment durations.

features.title: Private database
features.description: Appointments and customers live in a dedicated, project-scoped MySQL instance on your server.

configFields.label: Administrator password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Shown on the Connection card.

connection.title: Sign in to Easy!Appointments
connection.description: Sign in to the admin panel with the username and generated password below. The administrator is created on first start. Customers book from the main page; staff sign in at /index.php/login.

firstLogin.note: The administrator's login name is admin, and you sign in at /index.php/login on the app's address (the main page is the customer booking page). Account changes made in the app are preserved on redeployment. Outgoing email is not configured; add SMTP in the app under Settings > General or through the MAIL_* variables on the easyappointments service. The company name starts as My Company, so change it under Settings.
